scripts.title: Kill Aura
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local mobs = workspace:WaitForChild("Mobs")
local mobFolders = {
	mobs:WaitForChild("Regular"),
	mobs:WaitForChild("MegaBoss"),
}
local dealDamageRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("DealDamage")

local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet(
	"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/theneutral0ne/wally-modified/refs/heads/main/wally-modified.lua"
))()

local Flags = {}
local Window = Library:CreateWindow("Targeting")

Window:Section("Combat")
Window:Toggle("Kill Aura", {
	location = Flags,
	flag = "KillAura",
	default = false,
})

local currentTarget = nil

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not Flags.KillAura then
		currentTarget = nil
		return
	end

	local character = localPlayer.Character
	local playerRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not playerRootPart then
		currentTarget = nil
		return
	end

	local closestEnemy = nil
	local closestDistance = math.huge

	for _, mobFolder in mobFolders do
		for _, enemy in mobFolder:GetChildren() do
			local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local enemyRootPart = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if humanoid
				and humanoid.Health > 0
				and enemyRootPart
				and enemyRootPart:IsA("BasePart")
			then
				local distance = (enemyRootPart.Position - playerRootPart.Position).Magnitude

				if distance < closestDistance then
					closestDistance = distance
					closestEnemy = enemy
				end
			end
		end
	end

	currentTarget = closestEnemy

	if currentTarget then
		dealDamageRemote:FireServer({ buffer.fromstring(currentTarget.Name) })
	end
end)
